notes.title: DLC💝Bloody Painter Dating Sim - Valentine
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cbTBArsVgAA;full][/previewyoutube]

💝Download➔ [url=https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim-dlc-valentines-day]https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim-dlc-valentines-day[/url]

This Valentine DLC is a short special story that follows Ending 4-4, "Madman's Home," from Bloody Painter Dating Sim, with a playtime of only 20 minutes.
This DLC features a heartwarming and sweet story, with four new CGs and full voice acting.
We have also made major updates to the game system, including larger UI text for better mobile accessibility and animated character sprites.
